row.evidence: monday.com's support article says SCIM Provisioning is available on the Enterprise plan only, and the pricing page's full feature list shows SCIM provisioning, SAML SSO and Audit log only under Enterprise (custom price).
row.notes: Unchanged from June: SCIM is Enterprise-only (custom price). Basic $9, Standard $12 (special offer, list $14) and Pro $19 (special offer, list $22) per seat/mo billed annually. SAML SSO is also Enterprise-only; Google sign-in on Pro is not SAML. SCIM DELETE is a soft delete (deactivation); deactivated users stop counting toward paid seats. June's '~$40/seat/mo' Enterprise figure has no first-party source, so it is dropped. The GraphQL platform API is free on all plans (daily call limits by tier), so there is no API tax; the audit log API is Enterprise-only.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Google Single Sign-On (not SAML) from Pro.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Pricing page's expanded 'Complete features list' marks SCIM provisioning, SAML SSO and Audit log only under Enterprise (read from rendered table).

deprovision.data_retained: Deactivated users stay assigned to their tasks and their updates remain; workspaces they created stay active. SCIM DELETE is reversible.

custom.how: Custom user attributes accepted as string values.

roles.how: userType attribute: admin, member, viewer, guest, a custom role ID, or portal_user; strongest role wins when groups conflict.

rate_limits.text: Writes up to 450 per minute per account; reads up to 1000 per minute per account.

limitations.text: Filtering supports only eq on userName (Users) or displayName (Groups).
active and userType can only be changed with PATCH, not PUT; addresses not supported in PATCH.
Departments and team hierarchy cannot be managed via SCIM.
The admin who generated the SCIM token cannot be deactivated or demoted.
No hard delete of users via SCIM; DELETE deactivates.

auth.notes: Personal V2 API tokens; app tokens carry OAuth permission scopes.

capabilities.notes: Users are added by invitation (pending until accepted); teams are monday's groups.

endpoints.purpose: GraphQL query users: List or get users (users:read)
GraphQL mutation invite_users: Invite users to the account
GraphQL mutation update_multiple_users: Update user attributes
GraphQL mutation update_users_role: Change user role (default or custom)
GraphQL mutation deactivate_users: Deactivate users (admins only, max 200)
GraphQL mutation activate_users: Activate or reactivate users
GraphQL mutation add_users_to_team: Add users to a team
GraphQL mutation remove_users_from_team: Remove users from a team
GraphQL query audit_logs: read account audit logs (Enterprise)

rate_limits.text: Daily call limits: 1,000 (Free/Basic/Standard), 10,000 (Pro), 25,000 (Enterprise); plus complexity, minute, concurrency and IP limits.

okta.notes: OIN page marks SAML, SCIM and Create/Update/Deactivate/Sync Password/Group Push/Group Linking as checked (read from page markup).

google.notes: monday.com docs do not mention a Google Workspace provisioning app; Google sign-in on Pro+ is OAuth, not SAML.

onelogin.notes: OneLogin connector page not loaded; facts from monday.com's help centre.
